Statement guide, two columns
The quarterly statement below lists every
deposit and withdrawal recorded on the account
during the period. Balances are shown after
each entry, and the closing balance carries
forward to the next statement.
Interest is calculated on the average daily
balance and credited on the last business day
of the month. Fees, when charged, appear as
separate entries with a short description of
the service.
If you find an entry you do not recognise,
write to the address on the first page within
sixty days. Include the date, the amount and a
brief reason, and keep a copy of your letter
for your records.
Statements are also available as files you can
search and copy. Each page keeps its printed
look, while the words you select match the
words you see, so a search for an amount lands
on the right line.
Ordinary paper copies may arrive slightly
tilted after scanning. The text layer follows
each line at its own angle, so selecting a
sentence picks the words in reading order
rather than in fragments.
